{{{{{1|Seeds Infobox}}} |image = Void Seed |Crop = Void Root |Growth = 8 days |Season = {{Season|Winter}} |Sell Price = 0 |gPrice = ''Not sold'' |jPrice = ''Not sold'' |tPrice = ''Not sold'' }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' are a type of seed that can be planted in the {{Season|Winter}}. Mature plants yield [[Void Root]] after 8 days. Seeds cannot be purchased, but they can be obtained by eliminating [[Monsters|Shadow monsters]] in [[The Highlands|Crystal Cavern]] in [[The Highlands]] and by placing Void Root in the [[Stardew:Seed maker|Seed Maker]]. Mature plants yield a single Void Root per harvest, with a 2% chance of extra harvest per [[Stardew:Farming#Farming Skill|Farming Skill]] level. ==Summary== {{#lst:Crop Summaries|Void Root}} {{clear}}
